title: Scorecard in the Research layout
items: The Scorecard now uses the same numbered parts, grid and bordered panels as Research: 01 The record, 02 Against the market, 03 Calibration and results.
Model record and Against the price sit side by side, with the record and hit rate at the same headline size.
Against the market shows its three findings beside the agreed/disagreed table; calibration sits next to the four latest results, and View all opens the rest.
No new metrics; every panel carries the Graded label.
